items.title: Diblasio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Eric came down and he had that — he was a great player. And he said, “Look, they’re going to be looking for a bari player... I made a tape... Then I get a phone call and it’s — the offer says well we heard the tape and Maynard would like to have you come out.

ctx.x: Yeah, there’s a certain amount of yes to that I think yeah, but Maynard was, I mean this is a lot about Maynard but there’s not a day that goes by that I don’t think about this guy since I’ve been off the road because it was such an influence in a lot of different ways. So going back to that being ready for it, a friend from Miami, when I was going to school in Miami, was on Maynard’s band and he called and — I was finished my graduate program studies down there and I was going to stay in Miami. I wasn’t going to…
